description: Schema for packages/targets/*/config.json — declares how a target AI coding tool receives distributed files from the harness.

name.description: Canonical identifier for the target (e.g. 'claude', 'codex', 'opencode'). Keep as plain string to allow future targets.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in logs and reports.

configDir.description: Absolute home-relative path to the target's config directory (e.g. '~/.claude').

configDirEnv.description: Optional environment variable that overrides configDir for managed runtimes.

configFile.description: Name of the target's primary config file inside configDir (e.g. 'settings.json', 'config.toml', 'opencode.json'). May be empty for targets without a primary config file.

instructionsFile.description: Name of the primary instructions/memory file (e.g. 'CLAUDE.md', 'AGENTS.md').

obsoleteFiles.description: Exact configDir-relative files previously managed by this target. Push backs them up and removes them; unrelated files are preserved.

executables.description: Exact distributed destination paths that must be executable.

auxiliary.description: True for a distribution helper that is not an AI runtime and does not participate in the Core Workflow contract or runtime comparison table.

distribute.description: Map from destination path (relative to configDir) to a distribute entry describing where to copy it from.

extrasOverlay.description: When true, --push applies extras env.json / settings-overlay.json merge and skill-overrides for this target.

settingsSync.description: Declares which keys in the configFile are managed by the harness SSOT template (others are local-only).

source.description: Repo-relative path to the authoritative settings template.

format.description: Config file format. Defaults to json for existing settingsSync declarations.

keys.description: Top-level keys in the config file that are synced from source (others are preserved locally).

removeKeys.description: Obsolete dotted keys to remove from an existing JSON, TOML, or YAML config during push.

checkOnlyKeys.description: Live-first dotted keys (e.g. plugin enablement) that push never writes. --check reports entries present in the live config but absent from the template as 'unreconciled' so live-side additions get flowed back into the SSOT template.

localSource.description: Repo-relative path to a machine-local settings file (gitignored). When present with localKeys, those keys are merged into the live config from this file.

localKeys.description: Keys from localSource to merge into the live config. Only applied when localSource exists on disk.

extrasSource.description: Repo-relative path to a company/contract-specific overlay settings file (typically inside the private extras submodule). Skipped silently when absent (e.g. CI without the submodule).

extrasKeys.description: Keys synced from extrasSource instead of the SSOT template. Use for values that must not be committed to the public harness (company names, contract-dependent providers).

computedFeatures.description: Derives settingsSync keys/removeKeys from a feature table (packages/targets/codex/features.json) instead of listing features.* by hand: entries with declare true become keys, declare false become removeKeys.

table.description: Repo-relative path to the feature table JSON (see schemas/codex-features.schema.json).

prefix.description: Dotted-key prefix each feature name is placed under (e.g. 'features').

computedGlobs.description: Declares a computed overlay layer merged into the template before sync: danger-rules.json permission globs for this target are merged into mergeKey, so checked-in source files don't duplicate the SSOT danger-rules table.

table.description: Repo-relative path to the danger-rules.json SSOT table.

mergeKey.description: Dotted key path in the parsed template where computed globs are merged.

mergeShape.description: 'flat': mergeKey holds a glob->action map (merged via dict update). 'orderedPatterns': mergeKey holds a first-match-wins list of {match, approval} entries; computed deny entries are placed first, then prompt entries, then any pre-existing non-computed entries (omp bash.patterns).

computedSkillIgnores.description: Declares a computed overlay layer merged into the template before sync: the disabled-skills.json names for this target are merged into mergeKey as a list. For tools that also read another target's skills directory, where excluding a skill from distribution does not hide it.

target.description: Target name resolved against disabled-skills.json (core + extras).

mergeKey.description: Dotted key path in the parsed template holding the ignored-skill name list.

notes.description: Human-readable notes about this target's distribution setup.

skillsTransform.description: Controls frontmatter filtering applied to skill files during distribution.

keepFrontmatterFields.description: Frontmatter fields to retain; all others are stripped before distribution.

configManagedResources.description: Documents resources that the target manages via its own config rather than harness file distribution. Values are explanatory strings.

disabledPlugins.description: Plugin filenames (without .js extension) to exclude during distribution. Allows per-target flexible plugin control without runtime checks.

differences.description: Documents behavioural or structural differences between this target and the Claude Code reference target. Values are explanatory strings.

todoInvestigate.description: Open questions to investigate about this target.

deprecates.description: Commands or workflows that this target's configuration supersedes.

distributeEntry.description: Describes a single file or directory to distribute to the target's configDir.

oneOf.description: Multiple repo-relative source paths merged in order (later entries win on conflict).

expandIncludes.description: When true, `<!-- include: <repo-path> -->` directives in this file are expanded with the referenced fragment's content during distribution.

transform.description: Named transform to apply during distribution (e.g. 'removeClaude専用Frontmatter').

hookLibClosure.description: Only valid on a `<hooks dir>/lib/` directory destination whose source is the shared hook lib directory. Instead of copying the whole directory, distribute only the transitive closure of `$HOOK_DIR/lib/<name>.sh` references made by the hook files distributed directly under `<hooks dir>/` (libs sourcing libs are followed). A referenced lib missing from the source fails the manifest.
